title: 13:13 shake the heavens/earth shall remove out of her place. This prophecy, first recorded in Isaiah's writings, has since been repeated by many prophets and placed in the context of Christ's second coming (Joel 3:16; D&C 43:18; 45:48; 49:23; 84:118; Moses 7:61). 20 Both Haggai (Hag. 2:6-8, 21-23) and Paul (Heb. 12:26-29) explained this prophecy.
author: Tina M. Peterson
